# OpenGadTools (copy)

A copy of OpenGadTools' library (`DalsinAI/opengadtools`, `lib/`, branch
`lib/ogt-0.1-20261004` at f9ad6a2), so OpenMail builds on its own. MIT,
Copyright (c) 2026 Dalsin Limited. Change it there and copy it here again,
never here alone.

The themes OpenMail ships (`package/Themes/`) come from the same
repository's `themes/`.
